actions.script: const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.DriveServices.get#FilesData').call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {driveList: out.driveList, personalDriveId: out.personalDriveId, recordsDriveId: out.recordsDriveId, tagList: out.tagList, pendingShareCount: out.pendingShareCount, isAdmin: out.isAdmin, userId: ec.user.userId})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.resource.FileServices.get#DriveUsage').parameter('driveId', driveId || '').call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {usage: Array.from(out.usageList || [])[0] || null})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.DriveServices.find#FileRows').parameters({view: view || 'recent', driveId: driveId || null, path: path || null, tagId: tagId || null, text: text || null, fileType: fileType || null, modifiedPeriod: modifiedPeriod || null, modifiedByUserId: modifiedByUserId || null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {fileList: out.fileList, drive: out.drive, usedIndex: out.usedIndex})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.resource.FileServices.get#Versions').parameters({driveId: driveId || '', path: path || ''}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {versionList: out.versionList})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.resource.FileServices.get#Preview').parameters({driveId: driveId || '', path: path || '', size: Math.max(16, Math.min(Number(size) || 64, 2048)), sheetName: sheetName || null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {kind: out.kind, text: out.text, contentType: out.contentType, hasImage: out.kind === 'pdf' && !!out.previewLocation, pages: out.pages, rows: out.rows, sheetNames: out.sheetNames, sheetName: out.sheetName, truncated: out.truncated})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.DriveServices.get#ItemText').parameters({driveId: driveId || '', path: path || ''}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {text: out.text, versionName: out.versionName, canWrite: out.canWrite})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.DriveServices.search#ShareTargets').parameter('term', term || '').call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? [] : (out.optionList || []))

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.resource.FileServices.create#Folder').parameters({driveId: driveId || '', path: path || '', name: name || ''}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {newPath: out.newPath, messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: ec.resource.expand('Folder ${name} made', '', {name: name})}]})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.DriveServices.create#TextFile').parameters({driveId: driveId || '', path: path || '', name: name || null, text: text ?? '', versionNote: versionNote || null, replace: String(replace) === 'true'}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {newPath: out.newPath, versionName: out.versionName, messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: String(replace) === 'true' ? ec.l10n.localize('Saved') : ec.resource.expand('${name} made', '', {name: name})}]})

ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.resource.FileServices.delete#TrashForever').parameter('trashId', trashId || '').call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: ec.l10n.localize('Deleted for good')}]})

ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.resource.FileServices.set#Favorite').parameters({driveId: driveId || '', path: path || '', favorite: String(favorite) !== 'false'}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse({})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.DriveServices.share#Item').parameters({driveId: driveId || '', path: path || '', shareWith: shareWith || null, isLink: isLink || 'N', permissionEnumId: permissionEnumId || 'RspView', expireDate: expireDate ? ec.l10n.parseTimestamp(String(expireDate).length <= 10 ? expireDate + ' 23:59' : String(expireDate), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') : null, password: password || null, linkLabel: linkLabel || null, note: note || null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {shareId: out.shareId, linkPath: out.linkPath, notifiedUserIds: out.notifiedUserIds, messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: out.message}]})

ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.resource.FileServices.revoke#Share').parameter('shareId', shareId || '').call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: ec.l10n.localize('Sharing ended')}]})

ec.service.sync().name(answer === 'decline' ? 'org.moqui.resource.FileServices.decline#Share' : 'org.moqui.resource.FileServices.accept#Share') .parameter('shareId', shareId || '').call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: ec.l10n.localize(answer === 'decline' ? 'Declined' : 'Accepted')}]})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.resource.FileServices.restore#Version').parameters({driveId: driveId || '', path: path || '', versionName: versionName || '', versionNote: versionNote || null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {newVersionName: out.newVersionName, messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: ec.l10n.localize('Restored as the newest version')}]})

render-mode.text: ${JSON.stringify([{t: "dynamicContainer", id: "FilesTui", url: sri.buildUrl("../FilesTui").addParameters({drive: drive || null, path: path || null}).getUrlWithParams()}])}
Files is a .qvue screen: open it under /qapps.
